extracted.intended_audience: high-school students and teachers preparing for national mathematics olympiads (All‑Russian Mathematical Olympiad finalists), coaches, and problem‑solvers
extracted.subtask_description: A collection of contest problems from the 19th All‑Russian Mathematical Olympiad (Final Round, Anapa, April 1993) for Grades 9–11, intended as practice or competition problems in number theory, geometry, combinatorics, and functional equations. Each item is a standalone problem statement rather than evaluation guidance or production standards.
